app.name: HostBridge
app.tagline: Local DNS for virtual development domains
cli.description: Local DNS resolver and manager for virtual development domains.
cli.help_console: open the terminal screen (the default for the console build)
cli.help_service: run as a system service; started by the SCM or systemd, not by hand
cli.help_daemon_foreground: run the resolver in this console until interrupted
cli.help_repair: remove any resolution rules left behind and exit
cli.help_status: report what the daemon is doing and exit
cli.help_service_start: start the installed service and exit (requires elevation)
cli.role_unavailable: '{role}' is not available in this build yet.
cli.status_stale: Resolver: not running, but rules from an unclean shutdown may remain. Run --repair.
domain.error_wildcard_bare: A bare * would capture every name on this machine. Use *.example.test.
domain.error_wildcard_position: * is only allowed as the leftmost label, as in *.example.test.
domain.error_too_long: A domain name cannot exceed {limit} characters.
domain.error_empty_label: A domain name cannot contain an empty part.
domain.error_label_hyphen: '{label}' cannot start or end with a hyphen.
domain.error_label_chars: '{label}' contains characters that are not allowed: {chars}
domain.error_single_label: Add a suffix, for example .test -- a single-label name never reaches a DNS server.
domain.warn_mdns: .local is reserved for mDNS and is resolved without asking any DNS server. Consider {suggested}.
domain.warn_hsts_tld: .{tld} is on the browser HSTS preload list, so http:// is forced to https://.
domain.warn_wildcard_apex: A wildcard does not cover {apex} itself. Add it as a separate domain if you need it.
console.status_stale: resolver stopped, rules may remain -- run --repair
console.empty: No domains yet. Press a to add one.
console.keys_move: up/down choose - space on/off - a add - e edit - d delete
domain.name: Domain
gui.docker_no_daemon: The resolver is not running, so containers cannot be listed.
gui.banner_offline: The resolver is not running, so these domains do not resolve yet.
tray.minimised: HostBridge is still running. Open it again from here.
bootstrap.cancelled: Cancelled: the resolver was not started.
bootstrap.timeout: The resolver did not answer in time. See the log.
service.installed: The service is installed and started.
service.needs_elevation: This needs administrator rights. Run it from an elevated console, or use the button in the window.
service.needs_build: A service can only be registered against a built binary, not against a source checkout.
error.no_user: Cannot determine the current user account.
error.bind_in_use: Port {port} on {address} is already in use. Stop whatever holds it, or set a different listen address in settings.
error.bind_denied: Permission denied binding {address}:{port}. Run the resolver elevated.
error.policy_failed: Names were not registered with the system resolver: {error}
error.repair_failed: Could not remove the leftover rules: {error}
error.gui_unavailable: The desktop interface could not start: {error}
